notes: MuDHI (Multilayer Dielectric Haloscope Investigation) is a prototype dark photon search using a 23-bilayer SiO₂/Si₃N₄ chirped dielectric stack with a SPAD photosensor. The experiment searched for dark photons with mass around 1.5 eV/c² via DP-to-photon conversion in the dielectric stack. No signal excess observed; 90% CL upper limits set on kinetic mixing parameter χ. Minimum limit of χ < 6.86 × 10⁻¹¹ reached at 1.61 eV/c². The boost factor spectrum peaks in the region 1.4–1.8 eV/c² with uncertainty envelope shown in Fig. 11. Data points extracted from the exclusion curve in Fig. 11 and text statement of minimum limit. DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm³ assumed (standard galactic halo model). Polarization treatment assumes randomized DP polarization with averaging over coherence times, giving ⟨cos²θ⟩ = 2/3 as per Eq. (20). The paper notes that for constant polarization scenarios, directional and timing information could improve sensitivity comparably. Extraction confidence is high due to clear coupling type (kinetic mixing χ for dark photons), explicit numerical limit values in text and figure, and well-documented experimental methodology. | selector: text (sole candidate)
